name: alibaba_com_dropshipping-mcp
display_name: Alibaba.com Dropshipping center (pointer — global survey owns Alibaba.com) MCP
description: Alibaba.com Dropshipping center (pointer — global survey owns Alibaba.com) (ecommerce suppliers): me

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_ap.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_DROPSHIPPING_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_ap.description: App Key of your Alibaba.com Open Platform app (https://openapi.alibaba.com/ App Console; admin-reviewed).

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_ap.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_DROPSHIPPING_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_ap.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API path without '/rest' (e.g. /alibaba/order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value (docId=61). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_ac.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_DROPSHIPPING_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_ac.description: access_token from the authorisation-code exchange /auth/token/create (https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/api.htm#/api?cid=4&path=/auth/token/create). It expires after expires_in seconds; renew it with /auth/token/refresh (a signed call) and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_sh.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_DROPSHIPPING_SHIP_TO_COUNTRY
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_sh.description: Two-letter destination country used for product search and cost prices (shipToCountry / ship_to_country), e.g. US.

platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_cu.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_COM_DROPSHIPPING_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_alibaba_com_dropshipping_cu.description: ISO 4217 currency for search results and product prices, e.g. USD.

tools.name: me
tools.description: alibaba order list (role=buyer, one row): verifies the app signature and the buyer's access_token.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Product Search (buyer): keyword search of Alibaba.com products for the configured ship-to country and currency; `query` is required ('keyword', Required). Prices are strings in the configured currency; `id` is the product_id for get_product / quote_shipping.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get Product Description (buyer): title, images, skus[{sku_id, ladder_price, cost prices incl. shipping to ship_to_country}], MOQ and supplier. The mapped price/sku are the FIRST SKU's discounted procurement cost; stock comes from /eco/buyer/product/inventory (not mapped).

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Basic Freight Cost Estimation: shipping options for `quantity` units (required) of the product to `country`; each option's `code` (vendor_code) is create_order's shipping_option (carrier_code).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create BuyNow Order: places an unpaid order; pay it at `pay_url` or with /alibaba/dropshipping/order/pay. `items` are sent as product_list [{product_id, quantity, sku_id}], `shipping_option` (required) is a vendor_code from quote_shipping and `shipping_address` is Alibaba's shipment_address {address, alternate_address, city, province, country, country_code, zip, contact_person, telephone: {country, area, number}}. channel_refer_id is a fresh UUID.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: alibaba order get: trade_status (unpay, undeliver, delivering, …), amounts, order_products and shipping_address in `raw`; `created_at` is epoch ms.

tools.name: track
tools.description: Logistics Tracking: one row per parcel with carrier, tracking number, current event code and event_list[{event_code, event_name, event_location, event_time}].
